title: Ghost Ladder backtest is the sole clean critical path
content: Ghost Ladder carries no known leakage or contamination, but its walk-forward backtest (ghost-ladder-clean-backtest-wfv1) is planned-awaiting-executor with zero precision or stability evidence. Until the executor produces this run, the prospect cannot advance from Scouting.

title: Timmy live variants yield non-informative sample counts
content: Timmy-20-PC has 0 closed trades and Timmy-50-PC has 1 closed trade over ~29 hours. Both carry projection_unreliable and low_trade_count flags. Live runtime is producing unrealized PnL volatility without the statistical volume needed to validate or refute the parent AUC 0.61 model.

title: Dark Matter parent fails AUC gate with overlapping-window leakage
